sections.title: Welcome to Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Get a brief overview of what trigonometry is and why it's important.

sections.title: What You'll Learn: Mastering Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Define and identify the six trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine, tangent, cosecant, secant, cotangent).
Apply trigonometric ratios to solve problems involving right-angled triangles.
Understand and utilize reciprocal trigonometric identities.
Work through examples to find all ratios from a given ratio and verify identities.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary section, avatar with bullet points outlining learning objectives.

sections.title: Understanding the Six Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Define trigonometry and trigonometric ratios.
Identify the opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse sides in a right-angled triangle.
Recall the SOH CAH TOA mnemonic for sine, cosine, and tangent.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for illustrating right-angled triangles, labeling sides, and visually defining the ratios with formulas.

sections.title: Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities
learning_goals: Define cosecant, secant, and cotangent as reciprocals of sine, cosine, and tangent.
Write down the reciprocal identities.
Understand the relationship between the primary and reciprocal ratios.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can clearly present the reciprocal identities and their derivations using animated text and formulas.

sections.title: Example: Finding All Ratios from One Given Ratio
learning_goals: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find missing side lengths in a right-angled triangle.
Calculate all six trigonometric ratios when one ratio is given.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is perfect for a step-by-step walkthrough of constructing a triangle, applying Pythagoras, and calculating ratios.

sections.title: Example: Proving Angle Equality Using Sine Values
learning_goals: Demonstrate how to prove angle equality using trigonometric ratios and properties of similar triangles.
Apply the Pythagorean theorem in a problem-solving context.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can effectively illustrate the two triangles, their sides, and the logical steps to prove angle equality.

sections.title: Example: Calculating Pythagorean Identities
learning_goals: Calculate expressions involving squares of sine and cosine.
Understand the fundamental Pythagorean identity (sin²θ + cos²θ = 1).
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is suitable for presenting the formulas and showing the step-by-step calculation of the identities.

sections.title: Example: Verifying a Double Angle Identity
learning_goals: Verify a trigonometric identity using known ratios and algebraic manipulation.
Practice working with expressions involving multiple trigonometric functions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can clearly display the identity and the algebraic steps required for verification, highlighting each transformation.

sections.title: Example: Finding Ratios from Side Relationships
learning_goals: Solve problems where side lengths are given in terms of a variable.
Apply algebraic substitution alongside trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is excellent for visualizing the triangle with variable side lengths and demonstrating the algebraic steps to find the ratios.

learning_goals: Quickly recall the definitions of sine, cosine, tangent, and their reciprocals.
